data.name: パラパラパズル
data.detailed_description:
*Screenshots are from a work-in-progress build.

■About the Game

A brand-new puzzle experience, born from a collaboration between illustrator asaha's pixel-art animations and Gift Ten Industry.
The screen is filled with scattered pixel-art frames that, at first glance, seem to have nothing in common.
Swap the pieces to find the correct order — and the characters spring back to life, moving before your eyes.
The thrill of discovery ("Oh, that's how it connects!") meets the satisfaction of logical deduction ("If it moves like this, then the next frame must be...")—this is a fresh new kind of puzzle game that combines both.

■Story

One day, the precious animations saved on your PC were torn apart, frame by frame, by someone — or something.
Piece together the scattered fragments of data and restore each animation to its original form.
As you solve your way through the puzzles, keep an eye out for the mysterious letters that arrive along the way.

■Key Features

・A fresh take on sorting puzzles: spot the "change" between frames
Piece together the correct order by picking up on subtle differences in movement, motion trails, and the story unfolding within each animation. From looping animations to story-driven sequences, a wide variety of puzzle types await, each with its own way to solve.

・A charmingly quirky pixel-art world by asaha
asaha is a creator active mainly on Twitter and YouTube, known for pixel-art animations set to music and voice, as well as colored-pencil and watercolor illustrations that bring adorable characters to life. This game features a host of fan-favorite characters, including "Dokodoko Rabbit," "Dumbo Octopus," and "Kaiten-zushi-kun," each with their own quirky charm. Once completed, these animations are so cute you'll want to watch them again and again.

・36 puzzles packed with content
From simple puzzles you can breeze through, to challenging ones with 15+ frames that take real thought to piece together — a wide range of stages to enjoy at your own pace.

・Clear rewards: decorate your own space
Every time you clear a puzzle, you'll earn adorable goods featuring the characters you've met along the way. Arrange them freely on the display shelf around your PC and create your very own desktop space.

A charming world by asaha, unfolding one puzzle at a time. And who — or what — is really behind the scattered animations?

Why not open that door and find out for yourself?

data.short_description: Your animations got scattered — piece them back together! The adorable pixel-art animations by asaha, a creator active mainly on Twitter and YouTube, have been scattered by someone's mischief!? Rearrange the frames and bring their cute movements back to life in this fresh animation puzzle game.
